We compared regional grey matter volumes of 10 non-medicated male ADHD patients with comorbid cocaine dependence, 14 non-medicated male ADHD patients without cocaine dependence and 15 healthy control participants matched for age and premorbid intellectual functioning, using voxel-based morphometry (VBM) using both a whole-brain analysis and a priori ROI analysis based on the existing ADHD VBM literature.
Whole brain VBM analyses were performed using a one-way ANOVA design in SPM8 with total intracranial volume (TIV) as a covariate of no interest to correct for individual volume differences.

description.value: High-resolution T1-weighted structural MRI images were segmented into grey matter, white matter, cerebrospinal fluid, and skull using SPM8; a DARTEL template was created for intersubject registration; images were resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic voxels, modulated, normalized to MNI space, and smoothed with an 8 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel for voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: Subsequently, images were resampled to 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm voxels, modulated and normalized to MNI space and smoothed with a standard 8 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel.
